title: Closing and Funding Dispute Rules: Filing Window, Timelines and Outcomes
content:
## Filing window

A Closing and Funding funding dispute is accepted only if it is filed no later than the end of the dispute window that starts on the disbursement date. Count calendar days forward from the disbursement date, which is day zero; the window's length is the method's dispute window in calendar days, and a dispute filed on the last day of the window is accepted. A late dispute is resolved as denied untimely. The evidence is the closing's recorded disbursement date.

| Filed on (60-day window, hypothetical disbursement on 1 June) | Accepted? |
|---|---|
| 30 July | Yes |
| 31 July (day 60, the last day) | Yes |
| 1 August | No, resolved as denied untimely |

## Timelines

Larkspur acknowledges a funding dispute within the method's acknowledgment business days and decides it within the method's response business days.

## Outcomes by dispute type

- **Per diem overcharge and late funding disputes.** The clause "A per diem overcharge or late funding dispute is decided by recomputing prepaid interest under the per diem policy from the recorded disbursement date: any excess is refunded (refund issued, refund amount equal to the excess) and a correct charge is denied as correct as charged" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for deciding prepaid interest disputes.
- **Compensation on a late funding dispute.** The clause "A late funding dispute never earns compensation beyond the interest refund" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current late-funding basis.
- **Closing fee disputes.** A closing fee dispute reverses the fee (fee reversed) when the fee is outside the method's schedule or the redraw was Larkspur-caused.
- **Returned-wire interest disputes.** A returned-wire interest dispute is refunded only when the return was Larkspur-side.

## Decision record

Each decision names the filing record and, where the dispute is about one entry, that entry.
